summary: Fase 13 GDPR compliance testing — backend (consenti signup + retention job + legal-decline job + admin triggers) all PASS (13/13). Frontend: new CookieBanner + granular RegisterPage consent checkboxes work correctly. CRITICAL BUG: two cookie banners are rendered simultaneously — the NEW GDPR-compliant CookieBanner (App.js) plus the OLD CookieConsentBanner (PublicLayout.jsx) which lacks 'Rifiuta tutti' — old banner is the one visible on public pages, violating Provv. Garante 231/2021.

ui_bugs.issue: Two cookie banners are registered: App.js includes new GDPR-compliant <CookieBanner/>, but PublicLayout.jsx (line 197) still renders legacy <CookieConsentBanner/> with only 'Solo essenziali / Personalizza / Accetta tutti' (missing 'Rifiuta tutti'). Visible banner on public pages is the LEGACY one — violates Provv. Garante 231/2021 requirement of 3 buttons of equal evidence (Rifiuta / Personalizza / Accetta). Also the legacy banner uses different localStorage key ('fb_cookie_consent'), so user preferences set through new banner do NOT dismiss the old banner.

action_items: REMOVE legacy <CookieConsentBanner/> from /app/frontend/src/components/public/PublicLayout.jsx line 197 (and delete CookieConsentBanner.jsx + utils/cookieConsent.js if no longer used).

Ensure CookiePage.jsx (pages/public/CookiePage.jsx) is refactored to use the new STORAGE_KEY 'funzionabene_cookie_consent_v1' + applyConsent from cookieLoader, since it currently imports from legacy utils/cookieConsent.js.

Because public pages use PublicLayout, users see BOTH banners (or only the legacy one visually — depends on z-index/layout).
